title: Business Analyst
description: The application window is expected to close on: 11/18/2026Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.Meet the Team Cisco’s Global Supplier Management (GSM) organization is an industry-leading sourcing team in supply chain responsible for orchestrating direct material spend portfolio across strategic hardware commodities. Within GSM, the Cost Operations team operates as the central nervous system for enterprise hardware cost governance and quarterly cost roll-ups. We architect analytical models and digital quoting workflows that empower global commodity teams to make faster, data-driven decisions that optimize product margins and maintain supply resilience. Your Impact As a Business Analyst in GSM Cost Operations, you will be a key driver of commodity cost intelligence, quarterly quote cycle governance, and digital transformation. You will lead end-to-end quarterly RFQ quoting cycles, partner with Commodity Managers to structure complex component pricing strategies, and build advanced models that eliminate cost gaps and mitigate spend variances. In this role, you will champion the adoption of modern Generative AI, machine learning tools, and automated agent workflows to transform operational quoting into a predictive, autonomous capability. This position offers visibility, cross-functional leadership opportunities, and a platform to shape the future of digital supply chain operations at scale. What You'll Do Lead Strategic Commodity Quoting& Cost Operations: Orchestrate end-to-end quarterly and annual RFQ quoting cycles across assigned strategic hardware commodities. Govern quote intake, attribute drift analysis (MOQ, CT2R, COO, PSL, MPN lifecycle), and standard cost roll-ups in Oracle CG1 within strict fiscal timelines. Architect Advanced Analytics: Build dynamic simulative cost models and QoQ variance bridge models. Track and quantify cost, spend, savings, providing executive-ready insights. Drive Cost Hole Governance& cost Variance Mitigation: Identify cost holes, diagnose, and resolve missing component costs prior to quarter-end standard cost freezes. Oversee Purchase Price Variance (PPV) claim validations, supplier buydown liabilities, and Material Usage Variance (MUV) root-cause mitigation across manufacturing sites. GenAI& Digital Workflow Automation: Implement Generative AI tools, LLM prompt engineering, and automated agent workflows. Streamline supplier follow-ups and ideate and execute automation of manual activities. Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration& Process Excellence: Partner closely with Supply channel Leads (SCL), Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain Product Managers, Finance, and Contract Manufacturers to resolve operational bottlenecks, enforce master data integrity (Control Codes, Sourcing Rules), and mentor junior analysts. Minimum Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Finance, Operations Research, Economics, or a related quantitative field. (Master’s / MBA is a plus). Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience in hardware supply chain analytics, procurement cost engineering, direct material cost management, or financial operations within a high-tech or manufacturing environment. Advanced Excel Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel for complex financial modeling, multi-tab data reconciliations, nested functions (INDEX-MATCH, XLOOKUP, dynamic arrays), and Power Query data transformations. Financial Acumen: Strong financial acumen to evaluate the cost impact of non-material spend and correlate sourcing and manufacturing metrics to anticipate, identify, and communicate business and financial impacts. Business Intelligence& Data Modeling: Proven experience designing, deploying, and maintaining enterprise analytical dashboards and data pipelines in Power BI or Tableau, with hands-on proficiency in SQL / Snowflake queries. Generative AI& Automation: Demonstrated experience utilizing Generative AI tools, LLM prompt engineering, and basic scripting to optimize analytical workflows and business processes. Preferred Qualifications Hardware Domain& Costing Mechanics: Deep understanding of multi-tier hardware Bill of Materials (BOM) structures, component manufacturing cost drivers (wafer, assembly/test, packaging), and Non-Material Spend (PPV, Buydowns, MUV). Enterprise Systems Acumen: Working knowledge of enterprise ERP, PLM, and sourcing platforms. Ability to navigate in complex process environments. Utilize analytical and data driven approach to identifying solutions and decision making. Executive Communication& Storytelling: Outstanding ability to distill complex datasets into structured executive presentations Leadership& Problem-Solving Agility: Strong analytical problem-solving acumen, self-driven initiative, cross-functional influencing skills, and a passion for mentoring junior team members and driving continuous operational innovation. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. title: Business Analyst
description: Overview About Business Unit: Relied upon by leaders, associates and various verticals within Epsilon, the Finance team plays a key role in shaping our outcome-focused business culture. They devise solutions and provide insights that help keep our business on track, by collaborating and communicating with other teams. Empowered with an excellent ERP and forecasting system, this team of trusted partners support Epsilon India's day-to-day requirements and long-term business goals. How You'll Make an Impact: As a CRM Business Analyst, you will be a key member of the CRM Product & Data Operations team, supporting the Director in managing and continuously improving the company's CRM platform. You will serve as an important connection point between business users, the CRM team, and technical/development resources. A significant part of your role will be understanding what the business needs, translating those needs into clear requirements, managing the pipeline of issues and enhancements, coordinating testing, and helping ensure that changes are delivered accurately and efficiently. You will also become a knowledgeable resource on how the CRM is configured and used across the organization. You will research questions about system functionality, data, business rules, field usage, security, and user access, helping the team understand what the system is doing today and why . In addition to your core CRM responsibilities, you will support data-quality and cleanup initiatives and provide analytical and operational support to the broader Revenue Operations team as needed. Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. Responsibilities Business Requirements & Analysis Collaborate with business partners to understand their needs, problems, and desired outcomes. Conduct requirements-gathering sessions and translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements. Document business requirements, process flows, use cases, acceptance criteria, and expected outcomes. Ask the right questions to ensure requirements are complete, well understood, and aligned to the intended business process. Work with the Director to evaluate requests and determine appropriate solutions and priorities. Translate business requirements into clear documentation for technical and development teams. Help find opportunities to improve existing processes rather than simply replicating inefficient processes in the CRM. Maintain clear documentation of requirements and decisions throughout the development lifecycle. Issue & Enhancement Management Own the day-to-day management of the CRM issue and enhancement log/backlog . Capture, document, categorize, and track CRM issues, requests, enhancements, and defects. Ensure requests contain sufficient information for the CRM/development team to investigate and act upon them. Work with business users to clarify issues and determine expected versus actual system behavior. Research and investigate issues to determine root causes and potential solutions. Maintain accurate status, ownership, priority, dependencies, and next steps for open items. Coordinate with technical/development teams to track issues through resolution. Call out significant issues, risks, or competing priorities to the Director. Provide regular updates on open issues and enhancements to relevant partners. Help identify recurring issues and opportunities for permanent process or system improvements. Testing & Quality Assurance Lead or coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) for CRM enhancements, fixes, integrations, and other system changes. Develop test plans, test scenarios, test scripts, and acceptance criteria based on business requirements. Coordinate testing with business users and domain experts. Execute testing and document results, defects, and required changes. Work with development resources to troubleshoot and resolve identified issues. Conduct regression testing when appropriate to ensure changes do not negatively impact existing functionality. Validate that completed enhancements meet the original business requirements before recommending release. Maintain clear documentation of testing results and business sign-off. Help establish and improve the team's overall testing and release-management processes. CRM Research & System Knowledge Become a knowledgeable resource on the CRM's configuration, functionality, data, workflows, and business processes. Research questions about how the system works today , including fields, objects, workflows, automation, calculations, integrations, and dependencies. Investigate how specific fields are being used and by which teams, reports, processes, or applications. Research and document who has access to what within the CRM , including user roles, profiles, permissions, security groups, and other relevant access controls. Investigate questions related to user access, data visibility, record ownership, and security. Help determine whether observed system behavior is working as designed or represents a defect or configuration issue. Partner with the Director to maintain institutional knowledge of the CRM and ensure important findings are documented. Help maintain documentation of key system functionality, business rules, and processes. Data Quality & Cleanup Support ongoing CRM data-quality initiatives and cleanup activities. Identify incomplete, inaccurate, duplicate, or inconsistent CRM data. Research the source and root cause of data-quality issues. Implement or coordinate data cleanup activities in accordance with established governance and controls. Validate data before and after cleanup activities. Help identify patterns in data-quality issues and recommend process or system changes to prevent recurrence. Support development and maintenance of data-quality reports and monitoring processes. Partner with other team members responsible for CRM reporting and data management. Team Support & Operational Excellence Provide day-to-day support to the Director and broader CRM Product & Data Operations team. Support reporting, analysis, documentation, data cleanup, and other operational priorities as needed. Assist with CRM-related projects and special initiatives. Help prepare analysis and materials for business partners and leadership. Document processes and develop training materials or user guidance when needed. Serve as a flexible resource who can shift priorities as business needs change. Look for opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve recurring operational processes. Contribute to a culture of strong customer service, accountability, and continuous improvement. Stakeholder Partnership Build strong working relationships with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, IT, and other CRM partners. Serve as a trusted point of contact for business users with CRM questions or issues. Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences. Set appropriate expectations with partners regarding timing, dependencies, and resolution of issues. Help facilitate conversations between business users and technical/development resources. Raise issues appropriately while maintaining ownership of the problem through resolution. Qualifications Who You Are: A strong business analyst who enjoys understanding how a business works and how technology can make it work better . Naturally curious and willing to dig into a system to find answers rather than simply accepting that something "can't be done." Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple issues, enhancements, projects, and competing priorities simultaneously. A strong problem solver who can investigate an issue, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly. Detail oriented, particularly when it comes to requirements, testing, data, and system configuration. Comfortable working with both business partners and technical/development teams. Someone who takes ownership of issues and follows them through to resolution. Good communicator who can ask good questions and translate complex information into simple explanations. Comfortable operating in an environment where priorities change and the team needs people who are willing to pitch in. Interested in developing deep expertise in CRM technology, business processes, data, and operations. What You'll Bring With You: 3-6 years of experience in business analysis, CRM, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Systems, or a related field. Experience gathering and documenting business requirements. Experience managing issues, enhancements, tickets, or product backlogs. Experience developing and accomplishing test plans, test cases, and UAT. Experience working with Salesforce or another enterprise CRM platform. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong organizational and project-management skills. Experience working with business and technical teams. Ability to research and understand system configuration, workflows, data relationships, and user access. Strong Excel/data-analysis skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred. Why You Might Stand Out From Other Talent: Strong Salesforce experience, particularly with understanding configuration, security, workflows, objects, fields, and reporting. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics in addition to Salesforce. Experience supporting a CRM implementation, migration, or transformation. Experience working as a CRM Business Analyst, Product Owner, or Business Systems Analyst. Experience with CRM issue/enhancement management and backlog prioritization. Experience leading UAT for CRM implementations or major enhancements. Experience researching Salesforce security, profiles, roles, permission sets, sharing rules, and user access. Experience with CRM data-quality and data-cleanup initiatives. Experience working with CRM integrations and understanding upstream/downstream data dependencies. Experience working with Sales or Revenue Operations processes. Experience in a global organization with distributed business and technical teams. Experience with Agile development methodologies and tools such as Jira or similar platforms. Additional Information Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we've provided marketers from the world's leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels. Epsilon's comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world. Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day. People centricity: We focus on employee well-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other. Collaboration: We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals. Growth: There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement. Innovation: We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches. Flexibility: We've created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively. Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers. Act with integrity Work together to win together Innovate with purpose Respect all voices Empower with accountability These pillars and values are our foundation-shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose. Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.

Understanding of software engineering concepts and system architecture SQL and data analysis API and integration understanding (REST, JSON, XML) Process Mapping Gap Analysis Stakeholder Management Experience with Agile tools such as Jira, AWS, DevOps, or Confluence Retail and Digital Banking Payments and Card Processing KYC / AML Compliance Core Banking Systems Financial Products and Services Risk and Regulatory Requirements Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities Excellent communication and presentation skills Ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Strong facilitation and negotiation skills Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities Proven ability to read and translate Open API/Swagger Specs and UCRs to defi ne and document API requirements (user stories, acceptance criteria, data models) Experience delivering API/integration change across the full lifecycle, working with engineering, architecture, and 3rd parties. You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. This role is based in Bengaluru. Purpose of the role To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities. Accountabilities Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation. Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities. Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations. Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions. Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions. Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget. Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope. Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation. Assistant Vice President Expectations To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions. Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others. OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes. Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues. Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda. Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done. Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function. Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy. Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively. Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience. Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes. All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

The PTC team is responsible for the operational excellence of systems and processes used by Oracle’s indirect channel representatives and partners globally. Oracle’s partners are valuable as they help resell software, cloud and hardware products to end customers and their differentiated services combined with Oracle’s technology help enable our customers to achieve their business goals. The ideal candidate will have experience with managing partner relationships, implementing business and strategic functions, managing operations with multiple stakeholders, process optimization and work towards enhancing customer experience. Job Summary We are seeking a skilled Finance Analyst ( Finance Analyst Business Unit ) to join Accounts Receivable -Global Finance Services Division The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore Whitefield Office, KA -India What you will do We are looking for a Finance Analyst to join our Invoice to Cash team. This role is responsible for the end-to-end operational and accounting support for factoring business . This role will own periodically factoring operational tasks, including report running, document sign off, payment clearance, journal entry booking, reconciliation, and month end adjustment. The core objective is to ensure factoring operations run smoothly, accurately, and fully compliant with local legal, regulatory and accounting policy requirements. In addition, this role is expected to proactively identify process gaps, explore optimization opportunities, and drive ongoing process standardization to align with the global factoring framework. Key Responsibilities： End-to-end factoring transaction processing Run weekly dealer receivable reports, conduct transaction reviews, select eligible invoices for purchase, consider factoring limit, and finally generate Offer to Sale and Bill of Sale reports; process docsign; prepare and release payment as defined in the program workflow. Ensure data integrity, consistency and completeness for downstream analysis. Collect dealer payment information and execute accurate fund settlement to Cat Financial following standard process. Estimate upcoming dealer collection at month end, to facilitate appropriate accounting entries for both sides. Raise request to RTR to complete all factoring related journal entry booking, including Offer to Sale entries, discounts entries, and service fee. Ensure all accounting treatments comply with accounting policy, factoring agreement and regulatory requirements. Reconciliation, exception and variance management Prepare periodic reconciliations with Cat Financial, investigate variances, resolve exceptions and track outstanding/open items, actively follow up to drive timely closure. Support RTR to complete month-end adjustment entries and resolve intercompany discrepancy. Periodic reporting and stakeholder coordination Prepare regular operation reports for the factoring program. Coordinate cross-functionally with internal teams and external stakeholders (RBI, Tax authorities etc.) to resolve operational, accounting and compliance issues. Standardization and continuous improvement Drive process optimization and gap remediation, align with global factoring standard What you will have Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field. Experience: 3-5 years in Factoring operations , Accounts Receivable management or corporate accounting . Hands-on experience with factoring business is a strong plus. Systems Expertise: Preferred: SAP (CBS/Mach1) Having an expanded knowledge of Caterpillar’s businesses, products, suppliers, customers and policies. Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable fundamentals and the end-to-end Invoice-to-Cash process, including collections, cash application, account reconciliation and exception management. Financial and accounting knowledge to understand and apply the contractual rights, obligations and responsibilities of each party under the factoring agreement. Ability to understand the broader financial impact of factoring transactions, including cash flow, receivables, factoring costs, and period-end financial reporting Core Competencies Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. Communicating Complex Concepts: Knowledge of effective presentation tools and techniques to ensure clear understanding; ability to use summarization and simplification techniques to explain complex technical concepts in simple, clear language appropriate to the audience. Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Compliance awareness: Ensure all transactions, accounting treatments and fund flows comply with regulations and company policy, maintain complete audit trails. Cross-team collaboration: Work effectively with Cat Financial, RTR, Treasury and other internal teams to ensure smooth and timely execution of factoring operations and respond to any inquiry from tax authorities or RBI. Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way. Financial Analysis: Knowledge of tools and approaches of financial analysis; ability to read, interpret and draw accurate conclusions from financial and numerical material.
